rationale: The finding explicitly names the bypass: the handler instantiates InventoryRepository and writes directly to storage instead of going through InventoryReservationService (also restated in the summary as 'обработчик обходит InventoryReservationService'). It cites ADR-004 by number and path (docs/decisions/ADR-004.md:3-4) and quotes its rule text verbatim, corroborated by the repository docstring, so it is anchored to the specific decision rather than generic layering preference. The proposed fix — construct InventoryReservationService(InventoryRepository()) and call its save() — routes the write through the service and explicitly preserves the single write path. The location is cited as api_handler.py:7-8, which correctly matches the lines in the diff where the repository is instantiated and save() is called. All four criteria are satisfied.
